# Avnier

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 10 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Fashion e-commerce storefront: achromatic black-on-white Shopify chrome, Space Mono tracked-uppercase labels, licensed display titles, square zero-radius controls, mega-menu and side-drawer navigation, scheme-name CSS design tokens.

Captured 2026-11-11, signed out (every captured surface is public; checkout and account behind sign-in were never reached). Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Avnier's public shop — for building fashion-e-commerce surfaces in the style of the real thing. It was refreshed from **avnier.com** on **2026-11-21**, signed out, in **headless Chrome** at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844. The refresh covers the home page, the SHOP mega-menu, the all-products grid and its colour filter, `/products/doudoune-symphony` (size, colour, size-guide dialog), the side-cart drawer (`/cart` itself is a 404), the public `/account/login` gate (not submitted), contact and histoire, and the same shell at phone width. The site serves French copy (fr-FR) and EUR prices. The control map is [site-tree.md](site-tree.md).

Avnier is worth a capture because it is the reference for *monospace French streetwear*: an achromatic black-and-white storefront where Space Mono does all the work (body, nav, fields, buttons, prices — tracked uppercase on actions), a licensed display face (`avnier-font`) only for titles, square controls everywhere (0px corners, shadowless but for a 1px field ring), black buys on white paper, and a palette the Shopify theme declares as scheme custom properties (`--color-base-*` channel triplets, `--font-*` settings) — a real-world case of a storefront design layer on a Dawn-family theme.

## Typography

No composite type styles in tokens.json; the README text below names the faces and sizes.

### Fonts (from README.md)

**avnier-font** is the licensed display face — page titles at 188–220px (weight 500, 3% tracking) and product names. **Space Mono** (400) covers everything else: nav, body, fields, buttons, prices at 12–18px. avnier-font is not distributed; the style guide falls back to a system font. `@font-face` rules were recorded across the sheets in [raw/css-vars.json](raw/css-vars.json).

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **Readings past a masked bot signal.** The committed screenshots and readings were taken with `navigator.webdriver` masked, the flag bot checks read to spot automation. The capture scripts no longer mask it (not run since), so a recapture may record a walled route as a boundary instead of a reading.
- **One theme only.** A `dark` probe resolves to the same `:root` values — nothing paints dark. `.color-inverse` and `.color-accent-*` are section schemes that reuse the same black/white pair, not a dark mode. `tokens.json` ships no dark set.
- **The palette is channel triplets.** `--color-base-text` and friends declare `"0, 0, 0"`-style rgb() channels composed as `rgb(var(--x))` / `rgba(var(--x), α)`. `tokens.json` records the composed colour with the var named as its source.
- **Roles are verified, not declared.** Every `light` role pairs a var (or a measured colour) with the component that was measured wearing it; the theme declares only scheme colours, no semantic roles. The palette carries exactly two hues: the `#faf6b5` predictive-search highlight (`--PredictiveSearchHover`, `badge.promo`) and the `#f4ff7a` action yellow a press paints on the buy button's `::after` and the home CTA's underline (`core.measured.action-pressed`).
- **`component.*` tokens are measured**, not site variables. The shop declares no spacing or radius scale — corners are simply 0px.
- **The SHOP mega-menu is captured.** Hover on the first `.mega-menu__item` opens the dropdown on the same URL. See [home-light-megamenu](screenshots/home-light-megamenu.png). MARQUE uses the same panel and was not given its own shot this pass.
- **Search is an overlay.** The header Recherche control opens a dialog that stays on the page. See [home-light-search](screenshots/home-light-search.png). Nothing was typed into it.
- **Quantity and PDP accordions are absent on this product**, not missing measurements — the captured product (`pdp_url`) ships no `quantity-input` or disclosure rows.
- **The mobile-menu crop is the toggle region.** `m-menu-open` measures the menu button in its open state; the drawer's own box did not resolve for a crop — its rows are `m-nav-link` and the open panel is [mobile-home-light-menu](screenshots/mobile-home-light-menu.png).
- **Quantised screenshots.** `screenshots/` are 256-colour PNGs; read exact colours from tokens or `raw/full/`.
- **The PDP this pass is `/products/doudoune-symphony`.** Size S was selected for the variant shot. The size-guide dialog is [pdp-light-size-guide](screenshots/pdp-light-size-guide.png). Prices are EUR.
- **The first-order promo is a Klaviyo dialog.** It is recorded as it arrives in [home-light-promo](screenshots/home-light-promo.png), then hidden for the other shots. No name or email was typed. No code was requested.
- **The login form was not filled.** Email and password fields are on `/account/login`. Nothing was typed. Nothing was submitted. Create-account (`/account/register`) is a login wall and was not filled.
- **Focus styles were not systematically captured** beyond focus-visible states on the measured components.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do keep it achromatic.** White paper, black ink, black buttons, grey counts — the only hues are the pale-yellow `#faf6b5` search highlight and the `#f4ff7a` yellow a press wipes on actions. See [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png).
2. **Do go square and flat.** Buttons, chips, fields and tiles are 0px radius and shadowless; the single depth cue is the field's 1px shadow ring. See [add-to-cart-default](components/crops/add-to-cart-default.png).
3. **Do reserve black fills for actions.** AJOUTER AU PANIER, CONNEXION and the skip link are black rectangles with near-white tracked caps — never links or chrome. See [add-to-cart-hover](components/crops/add-to-cart-hover.png).
4. **Do track the labels.** Uppercase actions run 1–1.3px letter-spacing on 13–15px Space Mono; display titles carry 3%. See [nav-item-default](components/crops/nav-item-default.png).
5. **Do let Space Mono do the work.** Everything but titles is one monospace face — sizes, tracking and weight do the hierarchy, not a second family. See [card-price-default](components/crops/card-price-default.png).
6. **Don't ship a dark theme.** None is offered or declared; `.color-inverse` sections reuse the same black/white pair.
7. **Don't round the cards.** Product cards are borderless image+text rows, not boxed tiles. See [product-card-default](components/crops/product-card-default.png).
8. **Don't invent a second accent.** No status, sale or promo colour was measured on a component; the palette is black, white, wash and the search yellow. See [plp-title-default](components/crops/plp-title-default.png).
